catalog.message: Cached Channel3 API products; simulations make no catalog calls.

tables.name: simulation_runs
tables.description: One reproducible simulation and its clock. All dates use Asia/Manila business dates.

tables.name: merchants
tables.description: Fictional merchants. All sandbox receipts settle to the one connected test store.

tables.name: products
tables.description: Catalog snapshot. Sample or Channel3 provenance, provider ID, observed price and assumed unit cost.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Synthetic shoppers and segments; no personal data.

tables.name: campaigns
tables.description: Campaign definitions and planner-authored copy in workflows. Merchant coupons and marketing spend are simulated.

tables.name: events
tables.description: Impressions, views, carts, purchases, deliveries and refunds, with event timestamps and foreign keys.

tables.name: orders
tables.description: Generated purchase records; currency and all monetary fields reconcile in integer cents.

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: Product and quantity lines joined to each order.

tables.name: transactions
tables.description: Simulated payment ledger. Never sum these with the mirrored sandbox receipts.

tables.name: refunds
tables.description: Simulated buyer returns. These do not issue PayPal refunds.

tables.name: deliveries
tables.description: Simulated completed deliveries.

tables.name: inventory_movements
tables.description: Signed stock movements: sale negative, restock positive.

tables.name: campaign_spend
tables.description: Simulated ad cost, never charged to an ad platform.

tables.name: paypal_receipts
tables.description: Actual sandbox API receipts for a bounded sample of orders. Fictitious funds; actual provider IDs and fees.

tables.name: business_goals
tables.description: Operator objective and simulated budget. Discounts reduce sale proceeds; only outreach is additionally subtracted from contribution.

tables.name: campaign_assignments
tables.description: Persistent randomized treatment eligibility versus holdout. Assignment precedes outcomes; non-targeted treatment customers remain in the denominator.

tables.name: coupons
tables.description: One-day, single-shopper simulated offers. Ordinary seasons use merchant-funded coupons; Policy Lab explicitly models80% merchant/20% platform funding. No real retailer coupons are issued.

tables.name: coupon_redemptions
tables.description: One redemption per coupon, linked to the actual simulated order and discount.

tables.name: customer_days
tables.description: Pre-action observed features followed by that day’s offer and purchase outcome. Hidden preferences are excluded.

tables.name: model_runs
tables.description: Real CPU training runs, chronological validation, dataset hash, candidate metrics and portable fitted artifacts.

tables.name: model_scores
tables.description: Model-versioned purchase probabilities under 0%, 5% and 10% offers. These are our predictions, not Channel3 customer scores.

tables.name: team_decisions
tables.description: Recorded decisions with evidence and reasons. Source distinguishes scripted seasons from assistant-in-chat workflow planning; no app-hosted LLM is invoked.

tables.name: retention_results
tables.description: Mature 14-day randomized intent-to-treat outcomes among customers active at assignment; includes uncertainty and signed lift.

tables.name: policy_comparisons
tables.description: Matched-world comparisons under the same seed, catalog and shocks. Simulation evidence only.

tables.name: recommendation_models
tables.description: Fitted local affinity/popularity counts, frozen cutoff, chronological Recall@3 comparison, dataset hash and model artifact. Scores are rankings, not purchase probabilities.

tables.name: recommendations
tables.description: One customer/product exposure with its ranked alternatives, model, decision checkpoint, click and optional same-day order. Full-price recommendations cost an assumed 2 cents each. Association is not causal lift.

tables.name: marketing_planner_calls
tables.description: Actual continuous-planner LLM attempts: dated evidence, function output, public rationale, validation status, provider token receipt and estimated cost. Local workers and simulated shoppers are not counted as LLM decisions.

tables.name: agent_workflows
tables.description: Durable campaign missions and workflow state. Planner attribution distinguishes current-chat decisions from scripted demo coordination; tools execute locally.

tables.name: agent_checkpoints
tables.description: Idempotent tool requests, planner rationale, evidence references, attempts, status and saved outputs.

tables.name: campaign_plans
tables.description: Validated, versioned campaign specifications tied to real locally fitted models and bounded simulation budgets.

tables.name: campaign_customer_decisions
tables.description: One recorded decision per shopper and campaign day: observed inputs, model scores, inclusion/exclusion reason, coupon and model lineage.

tables.name: planner_sessions
tables.description: App-owned autonomous planner status and immutable per-campaign model-spend allowance. No credentials.

tables.name: planner_turns
tables.description: Persisted model inputs, public decisions, validated requests, provider token receipts and execution outcomes. Saved proposals resume without another inference call.

tables.name: paypal_operations
tables.description: Checkpointed agent choices and native PayPal API outcomes. Draft invoices and pending subscriptions are not payments. Scenario requests are labeled in evidence_json.

tables.name: paypal_money_events
tables.description: Verified native sandbox capture, refund and payout states. Provider timestamps are wall-clock time; these are samples, never additional simulated sales.

tables.name: policy_lab_runs
tables.description: Paired economy branches. Same seed, initial state and exogenous draws; settings and assumptions are frozen at creation.

tables.name: policy_lab_checkpoints
tables.description: Persisted LLM requests, evidence, decisions, provider usage and execution status. Public rationales, not private chain of thought.

tables.name: policy_lab_models
tables.description: Actual locally fitted contextual ridge bandits. Only mature past rewards enter fitting; temporal validation and coefficients are saved.

tables.name: policy_lab_merchants
tables.description: Independent numerical merchant policies: own stock and margins determine acceptable discounts. These actors are not LLMs.

tables.name: policy_lab_actions
tables.description: One shopper decision per day, including no action; eligible actions and selection propensity, linked order, intervention costs and delayed reward.

tables.name: policy_lab_daily
tables.description: Daily simulated commerce and modeled economic outcomes. Whole-market paired comparisons are simulator effects, not real customer ROI.

tables.name: v_marketing_transactions
tables.description: Orders + merchant + customer + campaign + simulated payment/refund + optional native sandbox receipt.

tables.name: v_daily_merchant_sales
tables.description: Sales-cohort date totals with ad spend. Refunds are attributed back to the original sale date.

tables.name: v_campaign_performance
tables.description: Campaign funnel, retained revenue, spend and ROAS; no causal incrementality claim.

tables.name: v_marketing_funnel
tables.description: Date × merchant × channel funnel counts.

tables.name: v_inventory
tables.description: Opening stock + signed movements = on-hand stock.

tables.name: v_customer_segments
tables.description: Segment-level purchases and retained revenue.

tables.name: v_coupon_journey
tables.description: Coupon → customer → merchant → Channel3 product → redemption → order → simulated payment.

tables.name: v_learning_daily
tables.description: Observed daily activity and live campaign outcomes, including offer cost and recorded purchase labels.

tables.name: v_model_history
tables.description: Model training and promotion history; real local CPU runtimes and validation losses.

tables.name: v_retention_experiments
tables.description: Randomized treatment/control retention rates. An estimate of aggregate prevented inactivity, never an individual saved-customer claim.

tables.name: v_recommendation_journey
tables.description: Recommendation → simulated click → optional same-day order → modeled transaction → optional native PayPal receipt. Provider and simulated amounts must not be added.

tables.name: v_paypal_order_lineage
tables.description: One row per selected emulator order: Channel3 product IDs, coupon, synthetic merchant/customer, and verified native PayPal sandbox order/capture/fees. Provider timestamps and modeled amounts remain separate. Never add mirrored provider gross to simulated revenue.

tables.name: v_paypal_agent_actions
tables.description: Agent rationale and evidence cutoff joined to Channel3 product, shopper, merchant and actual PayPal operation. No secrets or wallet tokens.

tables.name: v_policy_customer_journey
tables.description: Customer → policy/model → offer → order → simulated transaction/refund → optional PayPal sandbox receipt. Native samples are mirrors, not additional sales.

catalog.message: Cached Channel3 API products; simulations make no catalog calls.

tables.name: simulation_runs
tables.description: One reproducible simulation and its clock. All dates use Asia/Manila business dates.

tables.name: merchants
tables.description: Fictional merchants. All sandbox receipts settle to the one connected test store.

tables.name: products
tables.description: Catalog snapshot. Sample or Channel3 provenance, provider ID, observed price and assumed unit cost.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Synthetic shoppers and segments; no personal data.

tables.name: campaigns
tables.description: Campaign definitions and planner-authored copy in workflows. Merchant coupons and marketing spend are simulated.

tables.name: events
tables.description: Impressions, views, carts, purchases, deliveries and refunds, with event timestamps and foreign keys.

tables.name: orders
tables.description: Generated purchase records; currency and all monetary fields reconcile in integer cents.

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: Product and quantity lines joined to each order.

tables.name: transactions
tables.description: Simulated payment ledger. Never sum these with the mirrored sandbox receipts.

tables.name: refunds
tables.description: Simulated buyer returns. These do not issue PayPal refunds.

tables.name: deliveries
tables.description: Simulated completed deliveries.

tables.name: inventory_movements
tables.description: Signed stock movements: sale negative, restock positive.

tables.name: campaign_spend
tables.description: Simulated ad cost, never charged to an ad platform.

tables.name: paypal_receipts
tables.description: Actual sandbox API receipts for a bounded sample of orders. Fictitious funds; actual provider IDs and fees.

tables.name: business_goals
tables.description: Operator objective and simulated budget. Discounts reduce sale proceeds; only outreach is additionally subtracted from contribution.

tables.name: campaign_assignments
tables.description: Persistent randomized treatment eligibility versus holdout. Assignment precedes outcomes; non-targeted treatment customers remain in the denominator.

tables.name: coupons
tables.description: One-day, single-shopper simulated offers. Ordinary seasons use merchant-funded coupons; Policy Lab explicitly models80% merchant/20% platform funding. No real retailer coupons are issued.

tables.name: coupon_redemptions
tables.description: One redemption per coupon, linked to the actual simulated order and discount.

tables.name: customer_days
tables.description: Pre-action observed features followed by that day’s offer and purchase outcome. Hidden preferences are excluded.

tables.name: model_runs
tables.description: Real CPU training runs, chronological validation, dataset hash, candidate metrics and portable fitted artifacts.

tables.name: model_scores
tables.description: Model-versioned purchase probabilities under 0%, 5% and 10% offers. These are our predictions, not Channel3 customer scores.

tables.name: team_decisions
tables.description: Recorded decisions with evidence and reasons. Source distinguishes scripted seasons from assistant-in-chat workflow planning; no app-hosted LLM is invoked.

tables.name: retention_results
tables.description: Mature 14-day randomized intent-to-treat outcomes among customers active at assignment; includes uncertainty and signed lift.

tables.name: policy_comparisons
tables.description: Matched-world comparisons under the same seed, catalog and shocks. Simulation evidence only.

tables.name: recommendation_models
tables.description: Fitted local affinity/popularity counts, frozen cutoff, chronological Recall@3 comparison, dataset hash and model artifact. Scores are rankings, not purchase probabilities.

tables.name: recommendations
tables.description: One customer/product exposure with its ranked alternatives, model, decision checkpoint, click and optional same-day order. Full-price recommendations cost an assumed 2 cents each. Association is not causal lift.

tables.name: marketing_planner_calls
tables.description: Actual continuous-planner LLM attempts: dated evidence, function output, public rationale, validation status, provider token receipt and estimated cost. Local workers and simulated shoppers are not counted as LLM decisions.

tables.name: agent_workflows
tables.description: Durable campaign missions and workflow state. Planner attribution distinguishes current-chat decisions from scripted demo coordination; tools execute locally.

tables.name: agent_checkpoints
tables.description: Idempotent tool requests, planner rationale, evidence references, attempts, status and saved outputs.

tables.name: campaign_plans
tables.description: Validated, versioned campaign specifications tied to real locally fitted models and bounded simulation budgets.

tables.name: campaign_customer_decisions
tables.description: One recorded decision per shopper and campaign day: observed inputs, model scores, inclusion/exclusion reason, coupon and model lineage.

tables.name: planner_sessions
tables.description: App-owned autonomous planner status and immutable per-campaign model-spend allowance. No credentials.

tables.name: planner_turns
tables.description: Persisted model inputs, public decisions, validated requests, provider token receipts and execution outcomes. Saved proposals resume without another inference call.

tables.name: paypal_operations
tables.description: Checkpointed agent choices and native PayPal API outcomes. Draft invoices and pending subscriptions are not payments. Scenario requests are labeled in evidence_json.

tables.name: paypal_money_events
tables.description: Verified native sandbox capture, refund and payout states. Provider timestamps are wall-clock time; these are samples, never additional simulated sales.

tables.name: policy_lab_runs
tables.description: Paired economy branches. Same seed, initial state and exogenous draws; settings and assumptions are frozen at creation.

tables.name: policy_lab_checkpoints
tables.description: Persisted LLM requests, evidence, decisions, provider usage and execution status. Public rationales, not private chain of thought.

tables.name: policy_lab_models
tables.description: Actual locally fitted contextual ridge bandits. Only mature past rewards enter fitting; temporal validation and coefficients are saved.

tables.name: policy_lab_merchants
tables.description: Independent numerical merchant policies: own stock and margins determine acceptable discounts. These actors are not LLMs.

tables.name: policy_lab_actions
tables.description: One shopper decision per day, including no action; eligible actions and selection propensity, linked order, intervention costs and delayed reward.

tables.name: policy_lab_daily
tables.description: Daily simulated commerce and modeled economic outcomes. Whole-market paired comparisons are simulator effects, not real customer ROI.

tables.name: v_marketing_transactions
tables.description: Orders + merchant + customer + campaign + simulated payment/refund + optional native sandbox receipt.

tables.name: v_daily_merchant_sales
tables.description: Sales-cohort date totals with ad spend. Refunds are attributed back to the original sale date.

tables.name: v_campaign_performance
tables.description: Campaign funnel, retained revenue, spend and ROAS; no causal incrementality claim.

tables.name: v_marketing_funnel
tables.description: Date × merchant × channel funnel counts.

tables.name: v_inventory
tables.description: Opening stock + signed movements = on-hand stock.

tables.name: v_customer_segments
tables.description: Segment-level purchases and retained revenue.

tables.name: v_coupon_journey
tables.description: Coupon → customer → merchant → Channel3 product → redemption → order → simulated payment.

tables.name: v_learning_daily
tables.description: Observed daily activity and live campaign outcomes, including offer cost and recorded purchase labels.

tables.name: v_model_history
tables.description: Model training and promotion history; real local CPU runtimes and validation losses.

tables.name: v_retention_experiments
tables.description: Randomized treatment/control retention rates. An estimate of aggregate prevented inactivity, never an individual saved-customer claim.

tables.name: v_recommendation_journey
tables.description: Recommendation → simulated click → optional same-day order → modeled transaction → optional native PayPal receipt. Provider and simulated amounts must not be added.

tables.name: v_paypal_order_lineage
tables.description: One row per selected emulator order: Channel3 product IDs, coupon, synthetic merchant/customer, and verified native PayPal sandbox order/capture/fees. Provider timestamps and modeled amounts remain separate. Never add mirrored provider gross to simulated revenue.

tables.name: v_paypal_agent_actions
tables.description: Agent rationale and evidence cutoff joined to Channel3 product, shopper, merchant and actual PayPal operation. No secrets or wallet tokens.

tables.name: v_policy_customer_journey
tables.description: Customer → policy/model → offer → order → simulated transaction/refund → optional PayPal sandbox receipt. Native samples are mirrors, not additional sales.

tables.description: Synthetic shoppers and segments; no personal data.

tables.name: campaigns
tables.description: Campaign definitions and planner-authored copy in workflows. Merchant coupons and marketing spend are simulated.

tables.name: events
tables.description: Impressions, views, carts, purchases, deliveries and refunds, with event timestamps and foreign keys.

tables.name: orders
tables.description: Generated purchase records; currency and all monetary fields reconcile in integer cents.

tables.name: order_items
tables.description: Product and quantity lines joined to each order.

tables.name: transactions
tables.description: Simulated payment ledger. Never sum these with the mirrored sandbox receipts.

tables.name: refunds
tables.description: Simulated buyer returns. These do not issue PayPal refunds.

tables.name: deliveries
tables.description: Simulated completed deliveries.

tables.name: inventory_movements
tables.description: Signed stock movements: sale negative, restock positive.

tables.name: campaign_spend
tables.description: Simulated ad cost, never charged to an ad platform.

tables.name: paypal_receipts
tables.description: Actual sandbox API receipts for a bounded sample of orders. Fictitious funds; actual provider IDs and fees.

tables.name: business_goals
tables.description: Operator objective and simulated budget. Discounts reduce sale proceeds; only outreach is additionally subtracted from contribution.

tables.name: campaign_assignments
tables.description: Persistent randomized treatment eligibility versus holdout. Assignment precedes outcomes; non-targeted treatment customers remain in the denominator.

tables.name: coupons
tables.description: One-day, single-shopper simulated offers. Ordinary seasons use merchant-funded coupons; Policy Lab explicitly models80% merchant/20% platform funding. No real retailer coupons are issued.

tables.name: coupon_redemptions
tables.description: One redemption per coupon, linked to the actual simulated order and discount.

tables.name: customer_days
tables.description: Pre-action observed features followed by that day’s offer and purchase outcome. Hidden preferences are excluded.

tables.name: model_runs
tables.description: Real CPU training runs, chronological validation, dataset hash, candidate metrics and portable fitted artifacts.

tables.name: model_scores
tables.description: Model-versioned purchase probabilities under 0%, 5% and 10% offers. These are our predictions, not Channel3 customer scores.

tables.name: team_decisions
tables.description: Recorded decisions with evidence and reasons. Source distinguishes scripted seasons from assistant-in-chat workflow planning; no app-hosted LLM is invoked.

tables.name: retention_results
tables.description: Mature 14-day randomized intent-to-treat outcomes among customers active at assignment; includes uncertainty and signed lift.

tables.name: policy_comparisons
tables.description: Matched-world comparisons under the same seed, catalog and shocks. Simulation evidence only.

tables.name: recommendation_models
tables.description: Fitted local affinity/popularity counts, frozen cutoff, chronological Recall@3 comparison, dataset hash and model artifact. Scores are rankings, not purchase probabilities.

tables.name: recommendations
tables.description: One customer/product exposure with its ranked alternatives, model, decision checkpoint, click and optional same-day order. Full-price recommendations cost an assumed 2 cents each. Association is not causal lift.

tables.name: marketing_planner_calls
tables.description: Actual continuous-planner LLM attempts: dated evidence, function output, public rationale, validation status, provider token receipt and estimated cost. Local workers and simulated shoppers are not counted as LLM decisions.

tables.name: agent_workflows
tables.description: Durable campaign missions and workflow state. Planner attribution distinguishes current-chat decisions from scripted demo coordination; tools execute locally.

tables.name: agent_checkpoints
tables.description: Idempotent tool requests, planner rationale, evidence references, attempts, status and saved outputs.

tables.name: campaign_plans
tables.description: Validated, versioned campaign specifications tied to real locally fitted models and bounded simulation budgets.

tables.name: campaign_customer_decisions
tables.description: One recorded decision per shopper and campaign day: observed inputs, model scores, inclusion/exclusion reason, coupon and model lineage.

tables.name: planner_sessions
tables.description: App-owned autonomous planner status and immutable per-campaign model-spend allowance. No credentials.

tables.name: planner_turns
tables.description: Persisted model inputs, public decisions, validated requests, provider token receipts and execution outcomes. Saved proposals resume without another inference call.

tables.name: paypal_operations
tables.description: Checkpointed agent choices and native PayPal API outcomes. Draft invoices and pending subscriptions are not payments. Scenario requests are labeled in evidence_json.

tables.name: paypal_money_events
tables.description: Verified native sandbox capture, refund and payout states. Provider timestamps are wall-clock time; these are samples, never additional simulated sales.

tables.name: policy_lab_runs
tables.description: Paired economy branches. Same seed, initial state and exogenous draws; settings and assumptions are frozen at creation.

tables.name: policy_lab_checkpoints
tables.description: Persisted LLM requests, evidence, decisions, provider usage and execution status. Public rationales, not private chain of thought.

tables.name: policy_lab_models
tables.description: Actual locally fitted contextual ridge bandits. Only mature past rewards enter fitting; temporal validation and coefficients are saved.

tables.name: policy_lab_merchants
tables.description: Independent numerical merchant policies: own stock and margins determine acceptable discounts. These actors are not LLMs.

tables.name: policy_lab_actions
tables.description: One shopper decision per day, including no action; eligible actions and selection propensity, linked order, intervention costs and delayed reward.

tables.name: policy_lab_daily
tables.description: Daily simulated commerce and modeled economic outcomes. Whole-market paired comparisons are simulator effects, not real customer ROI.

tables.name: v_marketing_transactions
tables.description: Orders + merchant + customer + campaign + simulated payment/refund + optional native sandbox receipt.

tables.name: v_daily_merchant_sales
tables.description: Sales-cohort date totals with ad spend. Refunds are attributed back to the original sale date.

tables.name: v_campaign_performance
tables.description: Campaign funnel, retained revenue, spend and ROAS; no causal incrementality claim.

tables.name: v_marketing_funnel
tables.description: Date × merchant × channel funnel counts.

tables.name: v_inventory
tables.description: Opening stock + signed movements = on-hand stock.

tables.name: v_customer_segments
tables.description: Segment-level purchases and retained revenue.

tables.name: v_coupon_journey
tables.description: Coupon → customer → merchant → Channel3 product → redemption → order → simulated payment.

tables.name: v_learning_daily
tables.description: Observed daily activity and live campaign outcomes, including offer cost and recorded purchase labels.

tables.name: v_model_history
tables.description: Model training and promotion history; real local CPU runtimes and validation losses.

tables.name: v_retention_experiments
tables.description: Randomized treatment/control retention rates. An estimate of aggregate prevented inactivity, never an individual saved-customer claim.

tables.name: v_recommendation_journey
tables.description: Recommendation → simulated click → optional same-day order → modeled transaction → optional native PayPal receipt. Provider and simulated amounts must not be added.

tables.name: v_paypal_order_lineage
tables.description: One row per selected emulator order: Channel3 product IDs, coupon, synthetic merchant/customer, and verified native PayPal sandbox order/capture/fees. Provider timestamps and modeled amounts remain separate. Never add mirrored provider gross to simulated revenue.

tables.name: v_paypal_agent_actions
tables.description: Agent rationale and evidence cutoff joined to Channel3 product, shopper, merchant and actual PayPal operation. No secrets or wallet tokens.

tables.name: v_policy_customer_journey
tables.description: Customer → policy/model → offer → order → simulated transaction/refund → optional PayPal sandbox receipt. Native samples are mirrors, not additional sales.

disclosure: Recorded Gemini decisions and stored simulated shopper events. Playback makes no model or payment calls. The PayPal reference is an earlier verified sandbox transaction, not this shopper purchase.
